author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: the nodes were wired straight into a tiny head and the shoulder dome, so the icon read as a molecule or a bug, not a person. After: a clear user bust (r5 head 8 above the shoulder dome) stands alone in the centre, with three node discs on each side and short links pointing in toward the person, as in the reference.
omissions: The node circles are solid discs rather than hollow rings, and the links are short: hollow rings with longer links leave no room for the bust on a 40-wide canvas at 8 spacing.
